preconditions.description: The number of photos on the widget is between 3 and 1000.
The number of albums is between 1 and 40.
Each album contains between 1 and 1000 photos.

postconditions.expression: output == -1 or (len(output) == n and all(output[i] != output[i+1] for i in range(n-1)) and no two photos from the same album are adjacent)
postconditions.description: The output is either -1 if no solution exists, or a list of n album numbers where no two adjacent numbers are from the same album.
